name: Cosima Laube
bio:
I'm Cosima Laube, your versatile and experienced guide through times of change.

Alongside a broad foundation in psychology (BSc, FernUniversität Hagen) and professional coaching (ICF PCC with over 2,500 hours of experience), I speak fluent "IT & Tech".

I bring more than 17 years of leadership experience and 13 years in software development roles across a wide range of industries, including automotive, finance and banking, healthcare, e-commerce and tourism, and the public sector. I work with individuals, with groups and teams, and with entire organisational systems, from small and medium-sized businesses to global corporations.
role: independent agile leadership coach and socio-technical consultant
